b1plus-opinion-cha.title: Opinion Marker: -cha
b1plus-opinion-cha.explanation: -cha attached to a possessive form frames a statement as someone's opinion or perspective: menimcha (in my opinion), sizningcha (in your opinion), uning fikricha (in his/her opinion, literally "according to his/her thought").
b1plus-opinion-cha.fact: Menimcha alone, with no further words, is a complete and extremely common way to open an opinion in conversation -- it functions the way "I think" does in English, but packs subject, verb-like meaning, and stance into a single suffixed word.

dialogue.en: In your opinion, is this decision correct?
In my opinion, yes, it's correct.

b1plus-result-connector.title: Result Connector: natijada
b1plus-result-connector.explanation: Natijada ("as a result") opens a new sentence to state the outcome of what was just described: u ko'p mashq qildi. Natijada, imtihonni a'lo topshirdi (He/she practiced a lot. As a result, he/she passed the exam with excellence.)
b1plus-result-connector.fact: Natijada is built from natija ("result/outcome") plus the locative -da ("in/at") -- it literally means "in the result", treating an outcome as a place the narrative has arrived at, the same way -da marks arriving "at" a physical location elsewhere in the grammar.

dialogue.native: Yillar davomida mehnat qildi. Natijada, hozirgi o'rniga yetdi.
dialogue.en: He/she worked for years. As a result, he/she reached his/her current position.

items.en: In my opinion, this is the right decision.
In your opinion, will he/she come?
In his/her opinion, this issue is easy.
In our opinion, this solution isn't suitable.
In your opinion, who is right?
In my opinion, this is a very interesting idea.
In their opinion, prices will rise.
In my opinion, we shouldn't rush.
In your opinion, is this true?
In his/her opinion, everything will end well.
In my opinion, this is the best choice.
In our opinion, this matter is worth discussing.

items.uz: U ko'p mashq qildi. Natijada, imtihonni a'lo topshirdi.
items.en: He/she practiced a lot. As a result, he/she passed the exam with excellence.

items.uz: Yomg'ir uzoq yog'di. Natijada, ko'cha suv bosdi.
items.en: It rained for a long time. As a result, the street flooded.

items.uz: Kompaniya ko'p mablag' sarfladi. Natijada, sifat oshdi.
items.en: The company spent a lot of funds. As a result, quality improved.

items.uz: U ko'p sabr qildi. Natijada, maqsadiga erishdi.
items.en: He/she was very patient. As a result, he/she achieved his/her goal.

items.uz: Biz erta chiqdik. Natijada, vaqtida yetib bordik.
items.en: We left early. As a result, we arrived on time.

items.uz: U tinmay o'qidi. Natijada, ko'p narsani bildi.
items.en: He/she read tirelessly. As a result, he/she learned a lot.

items.uz: Ular hamjihat bo'lishdi. Natijada, ishni tez tugatishdi.
items.en: They worked together. As a result, they finished the job quickly.
Prices rose. As a result, sales decreased.

items.uz: U ko'p mehnat qildi. Natijada, muvaffaqiyat qozondi.
items.en: He/she worked hard. As a result, he/she achieved success.

items.uz: Biz rejani puxta tuzdik. Natijada, hammasi rejadagidek o'tdi.
items.en: We planned carefully. As a result, everything went as planned.

items.uz: U doim rostgo'y bo'ldi. Natijada, hammaning ishonchini qozondi.
items.en: He/she was always honest. As a result, he/she earned everyone's trust.

items.uz: Ishlar puxta bajarildi. Natijada, mijozlar mamnun qoldi.
items.en: The work was done thoroughly. As a result, the clients were satisfied.
